# List

The `List` component is useful to build vertical groups of interactive items.

Used by the <LinkTo kind="Components/Menu" story="docs">Menu</LinkTo> component.
See also the <LinkTo kind="Components/SideNav" story="docs">Side Navigation</LinkTo> component for an example usage.
